Dynamic Lead Goals
Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lease Goal ÷ 4-Wk Rolling Close Rate ÷ 4.33 weeks  ·  Edit the blue lease goal inputs to see all columns update live  ·  Close Rate = last 4 weeks from View B cohort tracker

📐 Formula: Monthly Leads Needed = Monthly Lease Goal ÷ 4-Wk Rolling Close Rate  ·  Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Leads Needed ÷ 4.33  ·  Lead Gap = Weekly Goal − Actual (negative = ahead)  ·  ✅ ≥ 100% of weekly goal   ⚠️ 80–99%   🔴 < 80%
